test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Your sister will say that she has lost her pen again.

options.text: Your sister said, "She has lost my pen again."
Your sister will say, "I have lost my pen again."
Your sister will say, "I lost my pen again."
Your sister says, "I lost her pen again."

solution:
The correct answer is **Your sister will say, "I have lost my pen again."**
